summary.headline: Astrological Doctrines and Configurations
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters on exaltations and depressions, stellar opposition, sect and trigonal lords, decans, terms, configurations, zodiacal sympathies, rays, spear-bearing, affliction, participation, and house-lordship, with Florentine codex folio references F. 192–195.
